document.abstract: This report of the Progress Committee covers the year 1936. The advances in the cinematographic art during that period are classified under the headings: (I) Cinematography, (II) Sound Recording, (III) Sound and Picture Reproduction, (IV) Publications and New Books; (Appendix A) General field of progress of the motion picture industry in Great Britain, (Appendix B) Motion picture developments in Austria, (Appendix C) Report of the activities in the cinematographic field in Germany during 1936.
